Wafer 8 Device 14 - Drift test, functionalized with pyrene-capped oligo

This was

Using 0.01X PBS for analytes, PBASE linking, and NANOBODIES (wildtype) (first time!!!!). This has pos and blank ctrls () no negative control. Important to note that 
    1) NO HEXAPRO in any wells, this was strictly done with no analyte
    1) Used 0.01X PBS for the analytes (kept 1X PBS for functionalization)
    2) used new PBASE opened 7/6/26
    3) Skipped PBASE dirac sweep
    4) Rigorous washing was done, washed after PBASE 4x with both DMSO then 1X PBS, as well as after nanobody with 1X PBS then 0.01X PBS

Nanobodies in 1X PBS overnight
tracking dirac curves (dirac pt, etc), not time-series tests
    Used 500 pts/V divisions for dirac tracking
    Sweeps are 0 to 1V
func started on 7/15/26, analyte tested on 7/16/26


The analytes are tested in wells:
(1): NONE
(2): NONE
(3): NONE
(4): NONE

Volumes and concentrations used:
functionalization:
    Pyrene-capped oligo, 2mM overnight in ambient air on stir plate at 18 rpm
analyte:
    None, just tested fror stability



Result:
    It drifted a lot... I tried rinsing a lot too


What could have gone wrong: (both from earlier)
1) DNA is in pieces due to 50+ freeze-thaw cycles
2) DNA contaminated from repeated use
3) Pyrene is not binding to the graphene because it's too concentrated, hence why I tried 2uM instead of 10uM like previous
4) Pyrene is not binding to the graphene because the DNA is getting tangled, hence why I tried the stir plate

What I can try:
1) Only run analyet tests about an hour of baseline measurements, 4 every 15 mins for example. Make sure it stabilizes in its entirety.
2) Order more oligos and pyrene-capped oligos
